exploit_name: Commission fees can always be bypassed via settlement ordering
description: Commission fee computes as min(premiumFee, notionalFee). When _settleOptions calls settleBurn with zero amounts (only premium realized), notional fee becomes zero, so commission becomes zero. Entire commission block is also skipped if realizedPremium == 0.
attack_scenario: User settles premium separately (commission = 0 when amounts are zero). Then burns position (no commission as realizedPremium == 0). All fees bypassed.
root_cause: Commission fee computes as min(premiumFee, notionalFee). When _settleOptions calls settleBurn with zero amounts (only premium realized), notional fee becomes zero, so commission becomes zero. Entire commission block is also skipped if realizedPremium == 0.
fix_description: Remove the realizedPremium != 0 guard. Derive commission directly from premium when shortAmount == 0 && longAmount == 0.
notes: Users avoid all commission fees by settling premium first then burning position.
